meaning: Real console hardware writing its own save: a PS2 to its memory card, an N64 to a Transfer Pak cartridge.
A software emulator or emulator front-end.
Hardware that reads a physical cartridge or memory card (Epilogue GB Operator, GBxCart RW, Sanni reader).
A flash cartridge that carries saves on real hardware (EverDrive, EZ-Flash).
A server-side producer, such as a sync or conversion service.
